نغلل (form I)
# نَغْلُلْ (naḡlul) /naɣ.lul/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# نُغْلَلْ (nuḡlal) /nuɣ.lal/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
# نَغْلِلْ (naḡlil) /naɣ.lil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
